newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down before opposition rally.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down before opposition rally.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed subdued on selling pressure on Wednesday ahead of an evening opposition rally in Karachi, dealers said. They said the index was likely to open lower on Thursday due to political unrest.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share price index fell 7.84 points, or 0.55 percent, to 1,423.43 amid 177 losers and 74 gainers. Volume fell to 16 million from Tuesday's 17 million.
The trading session remained dull as there was no positive news to lighten sentiment, dealer Ali Raza said. Major investors remained on the sidelines.
